channel.title: Sirene Labs
channel.description: Notes from the lab — build logs, experiments, and lessons learned.

item.title: cardinal — 2026-10-23
item.description: Shipped v0.7.0 of cardinal, the desktop overlay: true multimonitor. The world is one continuous panorama across the monitor union — not mirrored, not split at the seam — each panel at its native resolution, the HUD anchored to a selectable primary monitor with per-DPI scaling, the menu opening on whichever monitor the pointer is on, screenshots scoped to the monitor under the mouse, a fullscreen app blanking the whole desk to black, and the screensaver spanning both panels after a hotplug.

item.title: infrastructure — 2026-10-23
item.description: An overnight loop now proposes edits to our own code and keeps only what a script can prove is better. First target: memory — a probe parses twenty thousand holdings entries and the loop is told to make that peak smaller without changing behavior. It remembers every proposal across nights and re-tests when the code changes. The model proposes; a script vetoes.

item.title: sirene-finance — 2026-10-23
item.description: The advisor got hands: Sirene Finance now writes to the ledger it reads, and every write leaves a receipt on screen. Debts carry their rate, payoff month and due day; a coin row opens a sheet with the weekly purchase and the day it lands, projected with a tilde until confirmed; and one quantity has one price everywhere on the screen.

item.title: sirene-finance — 2026-10-22
item.description: Rebuilt the face of Sirene Finance: a layout that scales with the screen instead of capping at a fixed width, ember glass that lights where the pointer touches it, a transaction ledger with a leak panel, and a Guild Master who can be told to change a goal and actually changes it in the app.

item.title: cardinal — 2026-10-17
item.description: Shipped v0.6.9 of cardinal, the desktop overlay: a new notification system with an ember-inspired face — a grey slab, a solid orange frame with an orbiting beam of light, and drifting embers.

item.title: Hello, Sirene
item.description: The lab is open. What Sirene Labs is, what we'll write about here, and what to expect.
